---
title: "ProtPipe"
---

ProtPipe provides a consistent downstream-analysis workflow for processed proteomics results.

## Inputs

- Validated search output
- Sample metadata and comparison plan
- Group configuration template

## Workflow

1. Copy the example configuration rather than starting from an empty file.
2. Update only sample annotations, input paths, and the analysis-specific settings.
3. Submit the group-approved script on Biowulf.
4. Review QC, normalized quantitative tables, figures, and analysis reports.

<div class="callout">
Keep the configuration file with the output. It is the record of how the analysis was produced.
</div>

## Add to this page

Include your group&apos;s ProtPipe installation location, configuration template, example command, expected outputs, and a small example analysis.
